evidence.reason: The supplied code indexes _SCHEMA_TYPES[t] without validating the schema type name. A deployment local-review schema can legally contain the standard JSON Schema type "number", which is absent from _SCHEMA_TYPES, so schema_problem raises KeyError instead of returning a validation problem. That is an ordinary crash in existing validation behavior, not a new requirement. The minimal repair is to treat unknown type names as an unsupported schema observation rather than crashing.
